name: Stores Objects
description: A component (or a runner manager's cache) writes one type of object to an object store. The target is open: an S3 bucket (aws_core__aws_s3_bucket) here. GitLab recommends one bucket per object type; the registry and backups are configured apart from the consolidated form.

object_type.description: Which kind of object is stored there.

auth.description: How the component authenticates to the store (use_iam_profile, or an access key).
